en: This is a vintage postcard. The front side shows a monochrome photograph of a waterfront with several prominent buildings, including a distinctive tower and smaller structures, characteristic of early 20th-century Scandinavian architecture. The caption on the photo reads 'Wifstavarv', indicating the location. There is handwritten Swedish text in the lower portion of the image. The reverse side contains address lines, a stamp from Sweden, and preprinted text in Swedish, with handwritten address details to 'Fru Hedvig Hommer' in Visby. There is also a printed number '1518' and a stamp for 5 öre.
